name: Lithuania
contextBlurb: Lithuania applies MiCA to stablecoins and crypto-asset services. Stablecoins are permitted when issued as compliant EMTs or ARTs with authorisation, reserves, redemption rights, governance and AML controls. The Bank of Lithuania is the primary financial supervisor.

legislation.title: Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA)
legislation.summary: EU stablecoin framework for EMTs and ARTs, directly applicable in Lithuania.

stablecoinMeta.summaryEn: Lithuania follows MiCA. Stablecoins are legal with restrictions for authorised EMT and ART issuers, with EU reserve, redemption, disclosure and AML requirements.

regulators.name: Bank of Lithuania
regulators.role: Lithuania's central bank and financial-market supervisor for MiCA and crypto-asset service oversight.
